# CodeMirror 6

Generated from scripts/build/code-editor-entry.mjs with the exact versions in package-lock.json. Run `node scripts/build/build-code-editor.js` to rebuild, or add `--check` to verify. The editor and language modules load only when a file source view is opened.

Upstream: https://codemirror.net/ . Licenses for every bundled dependency are in LICENSES.txt.
